mainEntity.name: What is SERP.fyi?

acceptedAnswer.text: An advanced search intelligence platform that combines real-time Google search tracking with AI visibility audits.

mainEntity.name: Who is SERP.fyi built for?

acceptedAnswer.text: SEO professionals, digital marketing agencies, brand managers, and CMOs tracking modern search environments.

mainEntity.name: How is SERP.fyi different from traditional SEO tools?

acceptedAnswer.text: Traditional tools only track keyword rankings, whereas SERP.fyi tracks how both human search engines and AI systems understand your brand.

mainEntity.name: What is an AI visibility audit?

acceptedAnswer.text: An analysis measuring how often, accurately, and positively your brand is cited and recommended across AI search engines.

mainEntity.name: Which AI search platforms does SERP.fyi monitor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Major generative search platforms and LLMs, including ChatGPT, Perplexity, and Google AI Overviews.

mainEntity.name: What is the SERP Check Engine?

acceptedAnswer.text: A live tool scanning real-time search results across different keywords, devices, and geographic locations.

mainEntity.name: Does SERP.fyi use cached or outdated data?

acceptedAnswer.text: No, it provides real-time search intelligence to show accurate, up-to-the-minute ranking positions.

mainEntity.name: Can I track my local search performance?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes, it includes local search tracking to monitor maps, local packs, and regional ranking results.

mainEntity.name: What are search intelligence reports?

acceptedAnswer.text: Structured reports combining ranking metrics, AI citation signals, and performance trends into easy-to-read insights.

mainEntity.name: Can I use SERP.fyi data for client reporting?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes, agencies can generate clean, structured reports to share professional insights with clients.

mainEntity.name: Is SERP.fyi beginner-friendly?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes, it features a unified dashboard organizing complex search and AI data into a single interface.

mainEntity.name: How do I run my first audit on SERP.fyi?

acceptedAnswer.text: You can register on the platform, input your brand or target keywords, and run a live search and AI visibility scan.

mainEntity.name: What metrics are tracked in the unified dashboard?

acceptedAnswer.text: Live rankings, AI entity recognition, generative mentions, local visibility, and performance trends.

mainEntity.name: Is my search research and data private?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes, your keyword queries and analysis data are kept strictly confidential.

mainEntity.name: Who created SERP.fyi?

acceptedAnswer.text: It is an advanced search observatory tool developed as part of the BHMarketer ecosystem.

mainEntity.name: What is entity recognition tracking?

acceptedAnswer.text: It measures whether AI systems recognize your brand as a legitimate, established entity within their knowledge graphs.

mainEntity.name: Why are AI citations important for my brand?

acceptedAnswer.text: Modern users often get answers directly from AI summaries without visiting traditional links, making AI citations vital for exposure.

mainEntity.name: How does SERP.fyi handle zero-click searches?

acceptedAnswer.text: It tracks how your brand appears inside SERP features and AI answer blocks where traditional clicks are intercepted.

mainEntity.name: Can I track rankings across different countries and cities?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes, the platform supports multi-location and global market tracking to check local search conditions.

mainEntity.name: Does SERP.fyi track mobile and desktop rankings separately?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes, you can filter and scan real-time rankings across both mobile and desktop environments.

mainEntity.name: What are SERP features?

acceptedAnswer.text: Special elements on search engine pages like knowledge panels, local packs, image packs, and AI Overviews.

mainEntity.name: How does the platform detect changes in search intent?

acceptedAnswer.text: It analyzes top-ranking pages to evaluate how search intent patterns shift over time.

mainEntity.name: Can SERP.fyi help optimize content for Google AI Overviews?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes, by showing how your content performs against the specific criteria required to win AI summary citations.

mainEntity.name: What is signal mapping?

acceptedAnswer.text: The process of mapping out underlying signals, such as schema, authority, and structure, that influence your search placement.

mainEntity.name: How often is ranking data refreshed?

acceptedAnswer.text: Data is pulled in real-time to ensure you always see current search engine conditions.

mainEntity.name: Are historical performance trends available?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes, you can view how your rankings and AI visibility signals change over time within your dashboard.

mainEntity.name: Can I track competitor rankings alongside my own?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes, you can analyze competitor positions to see how they perform in both traditional SERPs and AI answers.

mainEntity.name: What does "LLM-Ready Signal Mapping" mean?

acceptedAnswer.text: It identifies the specific structural and trust signals determining whether an AI model recommends your brand.

mainEntity.name: How do I check if my brand is mentioned by ChatGPT or Perplexity?

acceptedAnswer.text: The platform's AI visibility scanner queries these generative models to track direct brand mentions and context.

mainEntity.name: Does SERP.fyi require any software installation?

acceptedAnswer.text: No, it is a cloud-based web platform accessible right from your browser.

mainEntity.name: Can I export my audit reports?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes, you can generate structured reports to export or present to stakeholders.

mainEntity.name: How does local pack heatmap precision work?

acceptedAnswer.text: It helps local businesses track exactly how visible their Google Business Profile is across different coordinates in a city.

mainEntity.name: What should I do if my AI visibility score is low?

acceptedAnswer.text: You can improve your entity footprint by building structured data, digital PR, and authoritative web mentions that LLMs frequently scrape.

mainEntity.name: How does SERP.fyi ensure accuracy in its data?

acceptedAnswer.text: By pulling live feeds directly from real-world search environments rather than relying on estimated or cached databases.

mainEntity.name: Can agencies white-label the reports?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes, agencies can present clean search intelligence metrics under their own workflow setup.

mainEntity.name: How do I start tracking a new keyword campaign?

acceptedAnswer.text: Simply add your target keywords and target location into your dashboard console to launch a live scan.

mainEntity.name: Does SERP.fyi track voice or conversational search trends?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes, by monitoring AI-driven answer engines, it covers the core components of conversational search discovery.

mainEntity.name: What is the benefit of a unified dashboard?

acceptedAnswer.text: It saves time by bringing traditional rankings, AI visibility, and local SEO metrics into one screen.

mainEntity.name: How can I get support if I have questions about my audit?

acceptedAnswer.text: You can reach out through the platform's support channels or contact the SERP.fyi search observatory desk.

mainEntity.name: How do I get started with SERP.fyi?

acceptedAnswer.text: Visit the website, explore sample reports, or sign up to run your first real-time SERP and AI visibility audit.
